headline: Chief Prosecutor: Killers of July uprising martyrs will be tried
summary: International Crimes Tribunal's Chief Prosecutor Aminul Islam says all martyrs' identities will be identified and justice ensured.
details: The International Crimes Tribunal's Chief Prosecutor, Aminul Islam, has announced that the identities of all martyrs from the July uprising will be identified to ensure the trial of their killers.
caption:
Justice for the July martyrs: The International Crimes Tribunal is working to identify every victim to bring their killers to justice.

The International Crimes Tribunal's Chief Prosecutor, Aminul Islam, has announced that the identities of all martyrs from the July uprising will be identified to ensure the trial of their killers.

headline_marked: 9 units of Fire Service [[bring garment warehouse fire under control]] in Narayanganj
headline: 9 units of Fire Service bring garment warehouse fire under control in Narayanganj
summary: The blaze broke out at a fabric warehouse of Ananta Apparels in the Adamjee EPZ, spreading rapidly due to chemicals and fabric.
details: A fire broke out at a fabric warehouse of Ananta Apparels in the Adamjee Export Processing Zone (EPZ) in Siddhirganj early today.
The blaze erupted around 4:15 am and was brought under control after approximately three hours of effort by nine units of the Fire Service and Civil Defence.
According to senior station officer Miron Mia, the warehouse was closed when the fire started, and the flames spread rapidly due to large quantities of fabric and chemical substances.
A unit from the Adamjee EPZ Fire Service responded first, with additional units from nearby stations joining as the fire intensified.
While small pockets of fire were still burning in some areas, officials stated there was no risk of the fire spreading further.
The cause of the fire and the extent of the damage will be determined following a formal investigation.
caption:
A garment warehouse in Narayanganj's Adamjee EPZ was engulfed in flames early this morning.

A fire broke out at a fabric warehouse of Ananta Apparels in the Adamjee Export Processing Zone (EPZ) in Siddhirganj early today.

The blaze erupted around 4:15 am and was brought under control after approximately three hours of effort by nine units of the Fire Service and Civil Defence.

According to senior station officer Miron Mia, the warehouse was closed when the fire started, and the flames spread rapidly due to large quantities of fabric and chemical substances.

A unit from the Adamjee EPZ Fire Service responded first, with additional units from nearby stations joining as the fire intensified.

While small pockets of fire were still burning in some areas, officials stated there was no risk of the fire spreading further.

The cause of the fire and the extent of the damage will be determined following a formal investigation.

#Bangladesh #Narayanganj #FireIncident #AdamjeeEPZ #News

Source: The Daily Star, Prothom Alo
